description: The order of a day (see main.zhang): which postings of the day of a definition or a close count, and the order of a month's events and postings.

known_issues.round_trip.beancount: KNOWN-ISSUE: a budget directive with a time is written to beancount with its date and time (`2024-02-15 18:00:00 custom "budget-close" "Fun"`), which zhang's beancount parser cannot read, so the round trip does not load, and which bean-check 3.2.3 rejects (`syntax error, unexpected NUMBER`); other directives move their time into a `time` metadata entry (extensions/beancount/src/lib.rs:163-169)
